```{r}
#| label: week04-setup-shootings-and-density-layers
#| include: false

# Load packages
pacman::p_load(ggspatial, gt, scales, sf, sfhotspot, tidyverse)


# Load data --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load shootings data
shootings <- crimemappingdata::nyc_shootings |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326") |>
  # Filter just those shootings that were fatal
  filter(murder == TRUE) |>
  st_transform("EPSG:6538")

# Load NYC police precincts data
precincts <- crimemappingdata::nyc_precincts |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  st_transform("EPSG:6538")

## Wrangle data ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate KDE
shootings_kde_nogrid <- shootings |>
  hotspot_kde(cell_size = 400, bandwidth_adjust = 0.33, quiet = TRUE) |>
  hotspot_clip(precincts)

shootings_kde_unclipped <- shootings |>
  hotspot_kde(
    grid = hotspot_grid(precincts, cell_size = 400),
    bandwidth_adjust = 0.33,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

shootings_kde <- shootings_kde_unclipped |>
  hotspot_clip(precincts)
```

## :angry: Not acting on last week's feedback

::: {.nobullets}
* Lines (**including comments**) over 80 characters long
* Comments that don't start with `#` _and a space_, e.g. `# This is a comment`
* Typos in file paths when saving/loading datasets (e.g. `bronx_shootings.csv`, `yc_shootings.csv`, `nyc.precincts.gpkg`)
* Cut-and-paste errors, e.g. using column names from the previous week's data
* Temporary code (e.g. `shootings_map`) included in script rather than run in 
  the R Console
:::

## :no_entry_sign: Misleading density layers

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
#### No density estimates for cells we _do_ have data for -- not great

```{r}
#| label: week04-map-density-missing-coverage
#| echo: false
#| fig-asp: 1

ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "cartolight", zoomin = 0, progress = "none") +
  annotation_spatial(
    aes(fill = kde),
    data = shootings_kde_nogrid,
    alpha = 0.75,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = filter(precincts, precinct >= 120),
    colour = "grey33",
    fill = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Reds", direction = 1) +
  fixed_plot_aspect(ratio = 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
:::

## :sunglasses: Non-misleading density estimates

```{r}
#| label: week04-density-clipping-code
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "3,7"

shootings_kde <- shootings |>
  hotspot_kde(
    grid = hotspot_grid(precincts, cell_size = 400), #<1>
    bandwidth_adjust = 0.33,
    quiet = TRUE
  ) |>
  hotspot_clip(precincts) #<2>
```
1. Provide a grid that covers the whole area you have data for
2. Clip the result to the area for which you have data

## :sunglasses: Labels that don't obscure the data layer


#### Option 3: only show some labels (advanced)

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| label: week04-high-density-precinct-labels-code
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "1-12,18"

# Identify precincts with highest density of fatal shootings
high_density_precincts <- shootings_kde |>
  # Join precinct names to KDE grid cells based on location
  st_join(precincts) |>
  # Convert from SF object to tibble to make `count()` faster
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  # Count total density of fatal shootings in each precinct
  count(precinct, wt = kde) |>
  # Keep precincts with highest density of fatal shootings
  slice_max(order_by = n, n = 10) |>
  # Join precinct names back to boundaries of precincts for mapping
  left_join(precincts, by = join_by("precinct")) |>
  st_as_sf()

hotspot_map(shootings_kde) +
  geom_sf(data = precincts, colour = "grey33", fill = NA) +
  geom_sf_label(
    aes(label = scales::ordinal(precinct)),
    data = high_density_precincts,
    alpha = 0.5,
    colour = "grey33",
    fill = "white",
    label.size = NA
  )
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

  count(precinct, wt = kde) |>
  slice_max(order_by = n, n = 10) |>

hotspot_map(shootings_kde) +

## :no_entry_sign: Cell size too big

::::: {.columns}

:::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| label: week04-large-cell-size-calculation
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| cache: true

shootings_kde_big_cellsize <- shootings |>
  hotspot_kde(
    grid = hotspot_grid(precincts, cell_size = 2500),
    bandwidth_adjust = 0.33,
    quiet = TRUE
  ) |>
  st_intersection(precincts)

cellsize_map <- ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "cartolight", zoomin = 0, progress = "none") +
  annotation_spatial(
    data = shootings_kde_big_cellsize,
    mapping = aes(fill = kde),
    alpha = 0.75,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = filter(precincts, precinct <= 119),
    colour = "grey33",
    fill = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Reds",
    breaks = range(pull(shootings_kde_big_cellsize, "kde")),
    labels = c("lower", "higher"),
    direction = 1
  ) +
  fixed_plot_aspect(ratio = 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| label: week04-large-cell-size-map
#| echo: false
#| fig-asp: 1

cellsize_map
```

## :no_entry_sign: Bandwidth too big

```{r}
#| label: week04-bandwidth-comparison-calculations
#| echo: false
#| include: false

bw_maps <- c(0.1, 0.33, 0.5, 1) |>
  map(function(bw) {
    shootings_kde_bw <- shootings |>
      hotspot_kde(
        grid = hotspot_grid(precincts, cell_size = 400),
        bandwidth_adjust = bw,
        quiet = TRUE
      ) |>
      st_intersection(precincts)

    ggplot() +
      annotation_map_tile(type = "cartolight", zoomin = 0, progress = "none") +
      annotation_spatial(
        data = shootings_kde_bw,
        mapping = aes(fill = kde),
        alpha = 0.75,
        colour = NA
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = filter(precincts, precinct <= 119),
        colour = "grey33",
        fill = NA
      ) +
      scale_fill_distiller(
        palette = "Reds",
        breaks = range(pull(shootings_kde_bw, "kde")),
        labels = c("lower", "higher"),
        direction = 1
      ) +
      labs(subtitle = str_glue("bandwidth_adjust = {bw}")) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(0, 6, 0, 0),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_textbox_simple(family = "mono")
      )
  }) |>
  patchwork::wrap_plots(ncol = 4)
```

## :no_entry_sign: Code that creates/overwrites unnecessary objects


```{r}
#| label: week04-unnecessary-objects-code
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "2,5,9,12"

# Load and wrangle fatal shootings in New York data
nyc_shootings <- read_csv(here::here("data", "raw", "nyc_shootings.csv"))

# Clean column names and convert to spatial data
nyc_shootings <- janitor::clean_names(nyc_shootings) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Transform fatal shootings data to a projected CRS (EPSG:6538)
nyc_shootings_projected <- st_transform(nyc_shootings, crs = "EPSG:6538")

# Filter only fatal shootings
fatal_shootings <- nyc_shootings_projected |>
  filter(murder == TRUE)
```


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


## :sunglasses: Use the pipe to avoid creating/overwriting objects unnecessarily


```{r}
#| label: week04-single-pipeline-code
#| eval: false

# Load and wrangle fatal shootings in New York data
nyc_shootings <- here::here("data", "raw", "nyc_shootings.csv") |>
  # Load data from file
  read_csv() |>
  # Clean column names
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  # Convert to spatial data
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326") |>
  # Transform fatal shootings data to a projected CRS (EPSG:6538)
  st_transform(crs = "EPSG:6538") |>
  # Filter only fatal shootings
  filter(murder == TRUE)
```

## :no_entry_sign: Comments after code on the same line

```{r}
#| label: week04-inline-comments-code
#| eval: false
hotspot_kde(
  # Start kernel density estimation function, which produces a KDE
  grid = hotspot_grid(cell_size = 400), # Set grid size to be 400 metres square
  bandwidth_adjust = 0.3, # Set bandwidth to be 30% of the default bandwidth
  quiet = TRUE # Prevent `hotspot_kde()` from producing messages as it goes along
) # End kernel density estimation function -- the results will be printed
```

# Reproducible examples

## How to fix errors in your R code

[Checklist for handling code errors](https://books.lesscrime.info/learncrimemapping/appendices/handling_errors.html)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


::: {.scrollable}
```{r}
#| label: week04-shootings-error-reprex-code
#| eval: false

# Load packages
pacman::p_load(ggspatial, here, httr2, sf, sfhotspot, tidyverse)


# Load data --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Download data from the web and save to local file
request("https://mpjashby.github.io/crimemappingdata/nyc_shootings.csv") |>
  req_perform(path = here("data", "raw", "nyc_shootings.csv"))
request("https://mpjashby.github.io/crimemappingdata/nyc_precincts.gpkg") |>
  req_perform(path = here("data", "raw", "nyc_precincts.gpkg"))

# Load shootings data
shootings <- here("data", "raw", "nyc_shootings.csv") |>
  read_csv() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:3246") |>
  filter(murder == TRUE) |>
  st_transform("EPSG:6538")

# Load NYC police precincts data
precincts <- here("data", "raw", "nyc_precincts.gpkg") |>
  read_sf() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  filter(precinct < 120) |>
  st_transform("EPSG:6538")


## Wrangle data ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate KDE
shootings_kde <- shootings |>
  hotspot_kde(
    grid = hotspot_grid(precincts, cell_size = 400),
    bandwidth_adjust = 0.33,
    quiet = TRUE
  ) |>
  hotspot_clip(precincts)


## Make map --------------------------------------------------------------------

hotspot_map(shootings_kde, basemap_type = "cartolight") +
  geom_sf(data = precincts, colour = "grey33", fill = NA) +
  geom_sf_label(
    aes(label = scales::ordinal(precinct)),
    data = precincts,
    alpha = 0.5,
    colour = "grey33",
    size = 2.25,
    label.size = NA
  ) +
  fixed_plot_aspect(ratio = 1)
```
:::
